consequence.statement: This is a new opt-in field that defaults to false. Existing policies behave as before unless spec.emitWarning is enabled, which the CRD description says extends admission request processing times.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds the optional boolean field spec.emitWarning (default false) to ClusterPolicy, so admission responses can carry warnings for audit-mode validate violations and for mutations.
